packages.description: PCB spiral coils and planar-motor windings with an English / Simplified Chinese interface.
packages.description_full: CoilForge creates PCB coils with the existing ActionPlugin and IPC/Tk interfaces. One PCM package supports KiCad 6–10.99. With the API disabled, SWIG-capable versions use built-in pcbnew/wxPython. With the API enabled, KiCad 9+ uses IPC and requires Python 3.10+ with tkinter, _tkinter, Tcl/Tk, venv and pip. KiCad 10.99 requires the API. IPC dependencies may need a package index.
packages.name: CoilForge
